title: Microsoft Teams: pop out the sign language interpreter video in meetings
summary: The briefing accurately reports the planned rollout and distinguishes existing interpreter video controls from the undocumented pop-out control. The cited Microsoft pages support the admin path, PowerShell call and general Teams licensing; targeted searches found no feature-specific default, control or charge.

claims.claim: IP video is reached in Teams admin center through Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Audio & video > IP video.
claims.quote: In the Teams admin center, go to Meetings, and then select Meeting policies. Select the policy you want to modify. Go to the Audio & video section. Check that IP video is turned On, then select Save.

claims.claim: MicrosoftTeams PowerShell supports Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowIPVideo $true to allow video sharing.
claims.quote: -AllowIPVideo: Determines whether video is enabled in a user's meetings or calls. Set this to TRUE to allow the user to share their video. -Identity: Specify the name of the policy being created.

claims.claim: The accessibility guide ties IP video to sign language interpreters sharing a video feed in meetings.
claims.quote: Give sign language interpreters the ability to share IP video feed during Microsoft Teams meetings so they can communicate with users who are deaf or hard of hearing.

claims.claim: Meeting policy settings apply to the users assigned the policies.
claims.quote: The CsTeamsMeetingPolicy cmdlets enable administrators to control the type of meetings that users can create or the features that they can access while in a meeting.

claims.claim: Mode for IP video controls outgoing and incoming video.
claims.quote: This setting controls both outgoing and incoming video for meetings and group calls that a user organizes or attends.

claims.claim: Mode for IP video covers meetings and group calls a user organizes or attends.
claims.quote: This is a both a per-user and per-organizer policy. This setting controls both outgoing and incoming video for meetings and group calls that a user organizes or attends.

claims.claim: Mode for IP video is unavailable in GCC, GCC High and DoD.
claims.quote: This setting isn't available for Microsoft 365 Government Community Cloud (GCC), GCC High, or Department of Defense (DoD) environments.

claims.claim: Outgoing and incoming video enabled is a documented value of Mode for IP video.
claims.quote: Outgoing and incoming video enabled | All attendees can use video unless the policy you assigned to them prevents it. | This user can use video unless the organizer's settings prevents it.
